Select A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR As AcGr,A.DATA_TYPE, SUM(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) AS AcAmt,SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) as GoldWt,sum(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END) ELSE 0 END) as SilverWt FROM AC_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' and VCH_DATE <= ' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ' ? C ? AND A.DATA_TYPE = ' ? ' ? GROUP BY A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR,A.DATA_TYPE HAVING SUM(CR_AMT - DR_AMT) < 0 OR SUM(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'G' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END )ELSE 0 END) < 0 OR sum(CASE WHEN A.IT_TYPE = 'S' THEN (CASE WHEN A.SIGN = '+' THEN A.FINE_WT ELSE -A.FINE_WT END) ELSE 0 END) < 0
